checkpoints.description: [1/4] Plan: close the remaining loop gaps. M1 binary_gcd (187 vs C 164 / Rust 139): diff the disassembly, find the per-iteration slack, fix; M2 nqueens (23.7 vs C 21.7 / Rust 17.6): try the recorded countdown-scan idea and any branching slack; M3 primes (24.1 vs Rust 18.4) and xorshift (287 vs C 278) peepholes as the gate data directs; M4 gate + delivery. Every fix ships a failing-first shape test; every change re-runs the --save --compare gate.

impact_assessment.why: the scoreboard still shows cairn behind C on binary_gcd, nqueens, primes, mandelbrot, xorshift and many_params; these are the same hot-loop constructs every real Cairn program leans on, so closing them raises the whole language
impact_assessment.benefits: contract: no source semantics change, only lowerings; identical results pinned by existing twin parity tests and e2e; dependency: machine.py helpers only; concurrency: none; state: codegen only, no new static data
impact_assessment.risks: contract: reordered or fused instructions must keep exact i64 wrap and flag semantics, or the parity tests catch it; dependency: low, existing encodings; concurrency: none; state: inline expansion may grow .text, bounded
impact_assessment.mitigation: contract: failing-first shape tests plus the 1073-suite and twin-parity after each milestone; the --save --compare gate must exit 0 before any commit; measured A/B against builds from the stashed tree; dependency: no hand-rolled bytes; concurrency: n/a; state: gate reports sizes

[1/1] plan: (a)+ homed two-name sum lowers as one lea over both homes (mandelbrot gap 14.1 vs C 10.6 traced to instruction count: 25 vs 16 per inner iteration; lea fusion closes most of it, measured -8.5% A/B and -12.8% in the gate); (b) later mechanism recorded, not attempted: leaf functions may home two more slots in r10/r11, the way gcc uses its volatile set when no call exists; (c) xorshift's gcc-only xor reassociation stays recorded from ADR-054.

impact_assessment.why: the lea fusion is a mechanical join of the copy and select work; mandelbrot was the largest non-folded C gap left
impact_assessment.benefits: contract: lea wraps like add, sets no flags, and every consumer still toys its own compare; dependency: one existing lea_scale encoding reused; concurrency: none; state: none, codegen only
impact_assessment.risks: contract: flag-dependent consumers must not lose the add (all zero-branches re-compare, verified); dependency: alias/delta slots refuse (delta abbreviates only); concurrency: none; state: text shrinks
impact_assessment.mitigation: contract: failing-first shape tests plus 1080-suite and value parity; gate exit 0 before commits; A/B same-window against a stashed build; dependency: REX/SIB verified by byte tests; concurrency: n/a; state: gate reports sizes

checkpoints.description: Phase 4: aikit.py check cairn 4/4 gates passed, checklists: passed; suite 1080 OK; gate exit 0 (mandelbrot improved -12.8%, no regressions). Ready to commit as feat [1/1].
[1/1] plan: two extra homes r10/r11 for frame functions, per-call push/pop, shrunken temp pool, str_byte guard

impact_assessment.why: contract: hot loop variables in frame functions stay register-resident instead of re-loading [rbp-..] each iteration
impact_assessment.benefits: contract: mandelbrot/primes/xorshift inner loops gain 1-2 extra live registers, targeting 5-8% on mandelbrot
impact_assessment.risks: contract: r10/r11 are caller-saved so every call clobbers them; dependency: TEMPORARY_REGISTERS pool indexing must shrink or temps clobber homes; concurrency: none, codegen is single-threaded; state: extras must reset per function or stale mappings leak across emits
impact_assessment.mitigation: contract: extras push/pop inside _emit_call_site and _emit_direct_indirect_call with self.depth tracking keeps rsp 16-byte aligned; dependency: derive temp_pool = TEMPORARY_REGISTERS minus extras and guard str_byte inline r10 scratch; concurrency: none; state: extras derived only when function.slots>6 so the frameless path stays byte-identical; failing-first shape test pins push/pop of r10/r11 around a call

checkpoints.description: pre-flight: contract/dependency/concurrency/state reviewed in plan; post-flight: 1082 tests OK, gate --save --compare exit 0 (all within noise, mandelbrot/str_scan/char_stream/splitmix improved), aikit.py check cairn 4/4, same-window A/B mandelbrot -6.6%; checklists: passed
[2/2] plan: M1 pointer binds into r10 + SIB byte load [ptr_home+idx_home]; M2 non-negative index skips the sign test; str_scan target 17.0 -> ~13.5 ms

impact_assessment.why: contract: str_byte's inline path pays 3-4 dead instructions per byte; the scan of a fixed literal has both pointer and index homed and an index provably >= 0
impact_assessment.benefits: contract: str_scan 17.0 vs C 13.0 ms; the same shape serves every string walk; 2 failing-first shape tests
impact_assessment.risks: contract: SIB load dereferences [base+index] before the sign check is skipped, so a negative index would fault; dependency: movzx lacks a base+index variant; concurrency: none; state: nonnegative_slots facts must still be dropped on any re-assign
impact_assessment.mitigation: contract: SIB form only when the index slot is provably non-negative at the point of load (fact kept by positive updates, dropped on any other store), otherwise the test/js pair stays; dependency: add movzx_load8_sib(base, index) to machine.py asserting neither rsp nor rbp; concurrency: none; state: nonnegative reuse is the existing divisor-guard mechanism, unchanged

[1/1] plan: inline read_char fast path (mov_load_rip cursor, cmp_load_rip bufend, movzx [rdx], cursor bump) with helper-call refill; runtime cursor as running pointer

impact_assessment.why: contract: read_char's fast path costs a call/ret plus ~12 instructions per byte; the byte搭 loop in char_stream pays it 4M times
impact_assessment.benefits: contract: char_stream 11.8 vs C 8.5 ms; inline fast path is 6 rip-relative instructions; failing-first ReadCharInlineTest
impact_assessment.risks: contract: an EOF refill loop must terminate exactly like getchar; dependency: machine.py lacks rip-relative load/store/cmp; concurrency: none; state: cursor/count layout changes to running-pointer semantics
impact_assessment.mitigation: contract: refill path keeps the n==0 EOF return and the short-read contract, inline falls back to one helper call; dependency: add mov_load_rip/mov_store_rip/cmp_load_rip with rel32 fixups; concurrency: none; state: buffer state internal to runtime.py, cursor becomes buf+index pointer, bufend replaces count
